card.title: Consequences Compound
card.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.text: Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
